notes.title: Post processing Update #1
notes.notes:
Update 1.2 – Post processing 


 New Features
SSAO: Added new render feature ambient occlusion

Depth of field: Added the depth of field for more realism

Blur on menu: When player is in menu theres now blur on the background  
Fixes
 Double hearing Fix: Resolved issues causing hearing from another player camera.

 Height player Fix : Resolved issues with player height diffrence.

notes.title: Inventory Update FIX #1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 – Inventory & Multiplayer Enhancements


New Features



Inventory System: Collect, manage, and organize items in a new inventory.


Item Interaction: Added the ability to pick up and drop items from de quick slot.


Quick Slots: Assign items to quick-access slots for faster in-game use.




Multiplayer Fixes



Synchronization Fix: Resolved issues causing desynchronization between players.
